empirical_case.asset_source: data/brka_d_ret.csv; decimal daily returns compounded within each month

empirical_case.validation: Monthly compounding agrees with month-end adjusted price ratios. NumPy OLS coefficients independently cross-checked with SciPy QR and statsmodels; maximum absolute difference below 3e-16.
empirical_case.reproduction: examples/advanced/analyze_course_factors.py; optional local input ZIP; aggregate output only
empirical_case.limits: In-sample attribution; no skill claim, no forecast, no recommendation. Current provider data may be revised. Raw supplied data is not redistributed.
